## **Sinclair, Inc. To Appear at Upcoming Investor Conferences**


11.10.2026


BALTIMORE, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Sinclair, Inc. (NASDAQ: SBGI) announced today that Narinder Sahai, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will participate in two investor conferences in December 2026. Both conferences will feature webcast fireside chats.


**Bank of America Leveraged Finance Conference – Boca Raton, FL**
Date: Tuesday, December 1
Fireside chat: 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time
Company executive: Narinder Sahai – EVP, Chief Financial Officer


**Wells Fargo 10** **th** **Annual TMT Summit Conference – Rancho Palos Verdes, CA**
Date: Wednesday, December 9
Fireside chat: 9:30 a.m. Pacific Time
Company executive: Narinder Sahai – EVP, Chief Financial Officer


Live webcasts and replays of the fireside chats at the Bank of America Leveraged Finance Conference and Wells Fargo 10th Annual TMT Summit Conference will be available under the “Events and Presentations” section of the Investor Relations website at[www.sbgi.net](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=jDGyEnqwEvzogf9G_IwVXiDHYZrqMUB4R4fdgK77Ti1SxI9v6WNI2O1kCt-FzzhvFE2idqH8JBFn3pXMA1hFZQ==) .


In addition to the fireside chats, Narinder Sahai will participate in investor meetings throughout both conference days. Institutional investors interested in meeting with Sinclair management may contact their respective conference representatives to arrange meetings.


About Sinclair:
Sinclair, Inc. is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 181 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; and owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts, and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.
